test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error.'**

The NCGG has been / set up to assist in / bring about governance reforms through studies.

options.text: bring about governance reforms through studies.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"bring about governance reforms through studies."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"bring about governance reforms through studies."**
 
• The given sentence must be in the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• The present perfect continuous is formed with have/has been and the -ing form of the verb.
 
• We normally use the present perfect continuous to emphasise that something is still continuing in the present
 
 
• **Example**: *She **has been living**__ in Liverpool all her life.*
 
 
 
• We must write** "bringing"** instead of **"bring."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The NCGG has been set up to assist in __**bringing about governance reforms through studies**__.*
